entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA2241 False negative with C# 14.0 extension() syntax with [StringSyntax] #57259
  • CA2241 false-positive diagnostic when using Composite [StringSyntax] on an extension method overload with a IFormatProvider parameter. #57258
  • [CI triage] TimeoutStartsWithFirstTestApplication times out waiting for cancellation on Windows FullFramework #57252
  • [CI triage] PositiveResultIsCachedForSixHours fails its first classification assertion on Windows FullFramework #57251
  • Regression: Explicit configuration value overwritten by environment variable since .NET SDK 11 #57243

Closed

  • [Known Build Error] ILCompiler NuGetAudit warnings #57002
  • Add short-form -v example to .NET CLI global options documentation #51926
  • `Octokit` failures need updated OneLoc task #57157
  • Allow provide translations for new languages #27257
  • `dotnetup install --default` rejects uppercase `SYSTEM` despite documentation #54542
  • `dnup` should use a separate user-agent header metadata tag for library calls #51433
    11.0.1xx
  • dotnetup: Re-enable installation validation via HostFxr on Unix platforms #52821
  • dotnetup: PowerShell profile may sync across machines #55591

PullRequests

Created

  • [wasm] Require the browser workload for CoreCLR native items #57257
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57256
  • Track additional ReadyToRun compiler outputs for incremental builds #57255
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix race in dotnet-watch RunsWithIterationEnvVariable test #57254
  • Improve code-review skill with checks that human maintainers often make #57253
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57247
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Add contextual parallel test output (backport of #57236) #57246
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 3141917 #57244
    Servicing-consider
  • Partition dotnet-new tests on macOS arm64 #57242

Merged

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Emit and capture UTF-8 in satellite assembly test #57209
  • Bump MSTest template dependencies to 4.5.3 #57249
  • Improve parallel test output in Azure Pipelines #57236
  • Skip servicing label for 11.0.2xx PRs #57229
  • Bump MSTest template dependencies to 4.5.3 #57248
  • [wasm] Remove Mono gate from Crossgen2 restore defaults #57222
  • Razor support in `dotnet format` 11.0.2xx backport #57245
    Servicing-consider
  • OpenHarmony: enable the SDK build (no installers or workloads) #56733
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.1xx' => 'release/11.0.2xx' #57221
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57132

Updated

  • Stop forwarding SDK location defaults to MSBuild #57174
    Area-MSBuild, Area-dotnet AOT
  • Enhance `dotnetup` `--no-progress` and add hookable json object progress reporting #57012
  • dotnetup: stop Windows installer downgrades from turning into failed repairs #57016
  • Honor value-content reachability in catch analysis #56606
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Reduce CA1851 and shared dataflow analysis overhead #57054
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix ordering races in dotnet-watch BrowserTests #57237
  • Use MSBuild server client for Native AOT commands #57224
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Backport CLI cancellation handling from #56332 #57228
    Area-CLI, Area-dotnet AOT
  • Add discovery-before-generation and AI-enablement gap guidance for agents #57215
  • dotnetup: enumerate system installs without loading hostfxr #56935
  • Verify downloaded template packages #57112
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57185
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Disable NuGet audit in SDK test processes #57231
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Test the in-repo TemplateEngine samples instead of the published package #57240
    Servicing-consider
  • Honor MSBuild -mt in dotnet run preparation #56837
  • Add zstd compression and Compression Dictionary Transport (CDT) support for static web assets #53836
    Area-AspNetCore
  • File-based apps: extend directive parsing APIs #57148
    Area-run-file
  • Add Local static web asset mode for server browser tools #57196
